name: How does crown molding installation actually work in a house?

mainEntity.name: How does crown molding installation actually work in a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding installation usually means measuring the room, cutting the molding to fit corners, fastening it to the wall/ceiling line, and finishing gaps with caulk and paint touch-ups. For most homes in the Denver metro area, a professional installer can usually handle the whole process with minimal disruption, but rooms with uneven walls or tricky corners take more time.
acceptedAnswer.description: It’s measured, cut, installed along the wall-ceiling line, then filled, caulked, and painted for a clean finish.
